summary: Luxfer Holdings PLC filed an 8-K reporting that the Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period for its take-private by Double Eagle Acquisition Buyer, Inc., a Wynnchurch Capital affiliate, expired at 11:59 p.m. EDT on September 8, 2026, satisfying one closing condition. The July 26, 2026 Transaction Agreement calls for Buyer to acquire all issued share capital via an English law scheme of arrangement under Part 26 of the Companies Act 2006, the UK equivalent of a US merger. Completion still requires shareholder approval and other regulatory clearances; a preliminary Schedule 14A proxy was filed August 26, 2026. Watch scheme-court and shareholder-vote timing.
